## Full-Scale Aerodynamic Assessment

Experimental campaign with a heavy-vehicle test platform equipped with rear-mounted aerodynamic devices, aimed at connecting controlled wind-tunnel findings with vehicle-scale behaviour under more representative operating conditions.
:::
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".media-reel-frame").forEach((frame) => {
    const slides = Array.from(frame.querySelectorAll(".media-reel-slide"));
    if (slides.length < 2) {
      return;
    }

    const reel = frame.closest(".media-reel");
    const dots = reel ? Array.from(reel.querySelectorAll(".media-reel-dots span")) : [];
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const autoAdvanceMs = 5200;
    const resumeAfterInteractionMs = 9000;
    let activeIndex = 0;
    let autoTimer = null;
    let resumeTimer = null;
    let scrollTimer = null;
    let pausedByHover = false;

    const currentIndex = () => {
      const frameCenter = frame.scrollLeft + frame.clientWidth / 2;
      let closestIndex = 0;
      let closestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

      slides.forEach((slide, index) => {
        const slideCenter = slide.offsetLeft + slide.offsetWidth / 2;
        const distance = Math.abs(frameCenter - slideCenter);
        if (distance < closestDistance) {
          closestDistance = distance;
          closestIndex = index;
        }
      });

      return closestIndex;
    };

    const updateDots = () => {
      dots.forEach((dot, index) => {
        dot.classList.toggle("is-active", index === activeIndex);
      });
    };

    const stopAutoAdvance = () => {
      if (autoTimer) {
        window.clearTimeout(autoTimer);
        autoTimer = null;
      }
    };

    const scheduleAutoAdvance = (delay = autoAdvanceMs) => {
      stopAutoAdvance();
      if (reduceMotion || pausedByHover) {
        return;
      }

      autoTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        goTo(activeIndex + 1, { wrap: true });
        scheduleAutoAdvance();
      }, delay);
    };

    const markInteraction = () => {
      stopAutoAdvance();
      if (resumeTimer) {
        window.clearTimeout(resumeTimer);
      }

      resumeTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        scheduleAutoAdvance();
      }, resumeAfterInteractionMs);
    };

    const goTo = (index, options = {}) => {
      const { smooth = true, wrap = false } = options;
      const targetIndex = wrap
        ? (index + slides.length) % slides.length
        : Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, index));

      activeIndex = targetIndex;
      updateDots();
      frame.scrollTo({
        left: slides[targetIndex].offsetLeft,
        behavior: smooth ? "smooth" : "auto"
      });
    };

    frame.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : null;
      const image = target ? target.closest(".media-reel-slide img") : null;
      if (!image || !frame.contains(image)) {
        return;
      }

      const slide = image.closest(".media-reel-slide");
      const slideIndex = slides.indexOf(slide);
      const rect = image.getBoundingClientRect();
      const goForward = event.clientX >= rect.left + rect.width / 2;
      goTo(slideIndex + (goForward ? 1 : -1));
      markInteraction();
    });

    frame.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
        event.preventDefault();
        goTo(activeIndex + 1);
        markInteraction();
      }

      if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
        event.preventDefault();
        goTo(activeIndex - 1);
        markInteraction();
      }
    });

    frame.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
      if (scrollTimer) {
        window.clearTimeout(scrollTimer);
      }

      scrollTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        activeIndex = currentIndex();
        updateDots();
      }, 80);
    });

    ["wheel", "touchstart", "pointerdown"].forEach((eventName) => {
      frame.addEventListener(eventName, markInteraction, { passive: true });
    });

    frame.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      pausedByHover = true;
      stopAutoAdvance();
    });

    frame.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      pausedByHover = false;
      scheduleAutoAdvance(1800);
    });

    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        stopAutoAdvance();
      } else {
        scheduleAutoAdvance(1800);
      }
    });

    goTo(0, { smooth: false });
    scheduleAutoAdvance();
  });
});
</script>

:::
